questions.question: Discuss the transition from Baroque seriousness to Rococo elegance.
questions.solution_html:
• The transition from Baroque to Rococo represents a shift from dramatic intensity to refined
  • elegance. Baroque art was characterized by grandeur, strong contrasts of light and shadow
  • emotional depth, and religious or political themes. In contrast, Rococo art embraced lightness
  • pastel colors, asymmetrical designs, and playful subjects like love and leisure. It moved away
  • from heavy seriousness toward decorative beauty and intimacy, reflecting the tastes of the
  • aristocracy and a more relaxed, pleasure-seeking society in 18th-century Europe.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: aristocracy and a more relaxed, pleasure-seeking society in 18th-century Europe.
